# Money invoice numbers and immutable history

- Use the existing decimal-safe money implementation with currency precision and explicit rounding. Recompute totals server-side; never use binary floating-point for monetary authority.
- Keep draft/issued/void separate from sent/delivered/bounced and unpaid/partially-paid/paid. Derive payment state from the ledger and overdue state from balance/due date/timezone.
- Allocate invoice numbers atomically per business/series on issuance. Drafts use IDs. Retain voided numbers forever; never reuse them.
- Snapshot business, client, lines, prices, terms and template details when issuing. Editing reusable records must not change issued documents.
- Treat requested deposits/instalments separately from received payments. Keep corrections/reversals auditable. Sending is not payment.
- Exclude draft/void invoices from receivables. Archive preserves records and balances. Display totals per currency, never an unconverted mixed-currency sum.
